text: How can I check UAE visa status?
groundTruth: You can check UAE visa status through the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship (ICA) portal at ica.gov.ae or using the UAEICP smart services app

text: How can I renew Emirates ID?
groundTruth: Emirates ID can be renewed online through ICA website or typing centers. Required documents include passport copy, photo, and current Emirates ID

text: How can I check traffic fines in UAE?
groundTruth: Traffic fines can be checked through MOI app, Abu Dhabi Police website, or Dubai Police website using vehicle plate number or traffic file number
